notes: Milestone 3: text arrives as live, editable After Effects text: fonts, sizes, colours and tracking (several in one layer), alignment, text-box width, line breaks, line height and paragraph spacing, upper case and small caps, superscript and subscript.
Line breaks and baselines come from Figma's own layout. If After Effects would break a line differently, Frame Bridge widens the box slightly or adds Figma's line breaks, and the report says so.

Fonts are checked with After Effects before every send. If one is missing, choose Cancel export, Recheck fonts, or Use Figma shapes (Figma's letter shapes with a switched-off live-text copy underneath). Frame Bridge never swaps in a different font.
Underlined, struck-through and list text arrives as Figma shapes with a live copy underneath. Text with a stroke, gradient or ellipsis stays an image.
Create test frames adds a Test text frame. Re-create the test frames to get it. Testing steps: docs/TESTING-M3.md.
testFocus: Re-create the test frames and send them all. Try each button on the font card, then compare the Test text frame against the Figma Reference.
Send a real client frame with plenty of text and send the report and diagnostics file.
